WeatherCurrent.description: WeatherCurrent sets the initial target and transition schedule for one weather channel.

actual.description: Actual is the initial target value for the channel, within its Limits.

duration.description: Duration is how long the channel holds Actual after reaching it, in seconds.

time.description: Time is how long the channel takes to reach Actual, in seconds.

WeatherFile.description: WeatherFile configures global weather simulation and the target ranges and transition behavior for each weather channel in `cfgweather.xml`.

enable.description: Enable determines whether the server runs the configured weather simulation.

reset.description: Reset determines whether mission startup replaces persisted weather with the values configured in this file.

storm.description: Storm configures when storms can occur and how long their thunder effects remain active.

weather.description: XMLName identifies the required `<weather>` document root.

WeatherMinMax.description: WeatherMinMax stores lower and upper numeric bounds for a weather setting.

max.description: Max is the upper bound or maximum transition value.

min.description: Min is the lower bound or minimum transition value.

WeatherSection.description: WeatherSection configures one weather channel, such as rain, fog, or wind.

changelimits.description: ChangeLimits sets the minimum and maximum size of a change between successive channel targets.

current.description: Current sets the initial target value, the time to reach it, and how long to hold it before the channel changes again.

limits.description: Limits sets the absolute minimum and maximum values allowed for this channel.

thresholds.description:
Thresholds gates a dependent channel on the value of its controlling channel.
For rain and snowfall, the controlling channel is overcast.

timelimits.description: TimeLimits sets the minimum and maximum duration, in seconds, between transitions to new channel targets.

WeatherStorm.description: WeatherStorm configures lightning generation during storms.

density.description: Density controls lightning strike density on a scale from 0 to 1.

threshold.description: Threshold is the overcast value, from 0 to 1, above which lightning may appear.

timeout.description: Timeout is the delay between lightning strikes, in seconds.

WeatherThresholds.description: WeatherThresholds controls when a dependent channel may be active based on the value of its controlling channel, and how quickly it stops when the value leaves the allowed range.

end.description: End is how long, in seconds, the dependent channel takes to stop after the controlling value leaves the allowed range.

max.description: Max is the maximum controlling-channel value that permits this channel.

min.description: Min is the minimum controlling-channel value that permits this channel.
